info.description: Page-level SEO metadata for search engines and social sharing

metaTitle.description: Page title for search engines (max 70 chars)

metaDescription.description: Page description for search engines (max 160 chars)

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL override (only when needed; most pages auto-generate)

ogTitle.description: Open Graph title for social sharing

ogDescription.description: Open Graph description for social sharing

ogImage.description: Open Graph image for social sharing

noindex.description: If true, page will not be indexed by search engines

nofollow.description: If true, links on this page will not be followed

noarchive.description: If true, search engines will not cache this page

nosnippet.description: If true, search engines will not show a snippet

maxSnippet.description: Maximum snippet length in characters (-1 for no limit)

maxVideoPreview.description: Maximum video preview in seconds (-1 for no limit)

schemaType.description: Structured data type (e.g. WebPage, AboutPage, FAQPage, ProductPage, Article)

alternateLanguages.description: JSON object for exceptional hreflang overrides
